# Collector fixtures

`nara-live-list.xml` and `nara-live-detail.xml` are actual credential-free XML
responses from dataset 15156780, fetched in GitHub Actions on 2026-11-01.
Provenance: https://github.com/ytbhana01-tech/midcareer-jobs/actions/runs/41297911356
The official dataset declares unrestricted use. These samples have no service key.
Tests change dates/counts only in memory to exercise pagination and expiry.

`nara-contract.json` and `busan-contract.xml` remain synthetic parser contracts,
not official responses. Busan remains disabled.
